profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a public company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, trading as CRM. Its Slack AI features page describes Slack AI as a tool that summarizes channels and threads, provides daily recaps, searches files, takes meeting notes, translates conversations, and automates workflows. The page says Slackbot is a personal AI agent that prepares for meetings, analyzes reports, and creates project briefs, and that Agentforce agents can run in Slack channels, threads, and direct messages. The company states customer data is not used to train large language models and that LLMs are hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud.

The product records list Slack AI, Tableau AI (Einstein), and Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce. Six third-party MCP servers are associated with Salesforce, covering administration, SOQL queries, and Salesforce DevOps planning and pipeline triggering.

Court records list 281 matters involving Salesforce in California. No specific lawsuits are listed in the available case records. The company's most recent annual revenue is USD 41525000000, reported on a 10-K for the period ending 2026-01-31.
